title: TenderRule
description: Tender-specific compliance requirement rule configuration per PRD §10

id.description: Unique identifier for the tender rule

ruleCode.description: Unique rule code (e.g. GSTIN_MATCH, TURNOVER_THRESHOLD, LEGAL_NAME_MATCH)

description.description: Detailed explanation of what the rule validates

ruleType.description: Category of rule (e.g. threshold, cross_match, presence, validity)

parameters.description: Arbitrary rule-specific configuration parameters and thresholds

severity.description: Default severity when this rule is violated

isRequired.description: Whether passing this rule is mandatory for compliance
